_comment: The lowest cli-printing-press version a NEW connector may be printed with. Read by check_press_metadata.py (CI fails a PR that adds a connector below it) and by msp-skills-publish's onboard.py (refuses to scaffold one). Existing connectors are not affected. The value mirrors upstream's own declared minimum; raise it here, in one place, when upstream raises theirs. not_press_generated lists connectors that were never printed by the press (slug -> reason); CI reads that list from the PR's base, so a PR cannot exempt itself.
